Marvel at the giant dinosaur skeletons, Canadian mammals, stunning minerals, and a real blue whale skeleton. Immerse yourself in the Canada Goose Arctic Gallery, an Ontario Signature Experience, and discover the captivating live exhibits such as Bugs Alive, the Pacific Discovery Tank, and Owls Rendez-Vous. Don't miss the awe-inspiring outdoor exhibition featuring live owls and a bald eagle. Uncover the museum's comprehensive exhibitions, housed in a beautiful heritage castle, covering everything from dinosaurs to climate change. Interact with live creatures, including owls, marine life, and insects, and gain insights into creating a more sustainable future for all from a scientific leader in species discovery and Arctic research. From dinosaurs to climate change, it's all here to discover across exhibitions located in a beautiful heritage castle Interact with live creatures, like owls, marine life, and insects, and don't miss the outdoor exhibits Learn how we can create a more sustainable future for all from a scientific leader in species discovery and Arctic research View all images What's included INCLUDED General admission to all permanent galleries and exhibitions Featured exhibition (ticket upgrade available during checkout) Coat check & WiFi Access to Nature Café and Boutique Applicable taxes & processing fees NOT INCLUDED Workshops & special event programming Parking (please note: paid parking is available onsite) Customer reviews 4.6 26 verified reviews 1 2 3 4 5 See all reviews Additional information Must Know Museum opening hours vary seasonally Children must be accompanied by an adult On Thursdays, the Museum is open until 8:00 PM and entry after 5:00 PM is complimentary Pre Purchase Children under 3 are free The last entry time is an hour and 15 minutes before closing Usage Scan your mobile ticket with the admissions staff upon arrival. Post Purchase Wheelchair accessibility via the main entrance only Paid parking is available onsite Nature Café is open with a take-out menu of healthy food and drinks from the local company, My Catering Group. Discover an exciting selection of souvenirs at the Nature Boutique! Gallery map PDF link attached Good To Know Wheelchair Access: Yes Bug Adventure Featured Exhibit, on view from March 15 through October 14 (additional ticket required) Venture through fantastical decor that lets you experience the world as bugs do. There are interactive surprises around every corner. Come face-to-face with bug characteristics of camouflage, venom, swarming, and flight. Test yourself against bugs with interactive games—how many flying bugs can you catch in 30 seconds? Discover how bugs inspired experts to make flying robots, nanotechnology, 3D-printed silk and more! Safety Warning: Solar Eclipse On April 8, the Ottawa area will experience a near-total eclipse The eclipse will begin at 2:11 p.m. and end at 4:35 p.m Looking directly at the sun without proper protection can lead to serious injury Special eclipse glasses must always be worn when viewing the eclipse and are used at your own risk. The Canadian Museum of Nature is not responsible for any injuries caused by viewing the eclipse. Opening Hours Wednesday: Start time: 09:30 - End Time: 16:00. Monday : Start time: 09:30 - End Time: 16:00. Tuesday : Closed. Location Venue Canadian Museum of Nature / Musée canadien de la nature, 240 McLeod Street, ON K2P 2R1 Meeting Point 240 McLeod Street Provider Canadian Museum of Nature Frequently asked questions How long does it take to see the Canadian Museum of Nature? It typically takes 2 to 3 hours to see the main exhibits at the Canadian Museum of Nature. What to see at the Canadian Museum of Nature? Highlights at the Canadian Museum of Nature include dinosaur fossils, the Arctic Gallery, mineral displays, live insects, and interactive exhibitions. Is the Canadian Museum of Nature free? The Canadian Museum of Nature charges admission, but free entry is occasionally offered on special days or evenings. Have another question?
